How to apply
Thank you for your interest in our program! We encourage you to complete your application using the online application program available through the School of Graduate Studies website.
Please note that in order for your application to be deemed complete, two references are required.
For the research based MSc/PhD program, we recommend you make initial communication with a faculty member in your area of interest/expertise prior to beginning the application process to determine whether that faculty member will be accepting students for the upcoming academic cycle. Students considering graduate studies are encouraged to begin a dialogue with a potential supervisor as early as possible in the admission cycle.
All applications are reviewed by our Graduate Program Admission Committee.
